category: Supply Chain Sustainability and Risk Management

tiers.name: Freemium
tiers.features: It includes the Supplier Pylon, which is a supplier engagement and relationship management platform that provides a centralized hub for insights, detailed supplier profiles, and an AI-powered RFP matchmaking engine

tiers.name: Supplier Plan
tiers.features: This plan is for individual suppliers who want to increase visibility and win more contracts. It includes the Supplier Pylon, which is a supplier engagement and relationship management platform that provides a centralized hub for insights, detailed supplier profiles, and an AI-powered RFP matchmaking engine. The plan also includes features from DivedIn AI, an AI-powered platform for compliance and risk analytics, specifically the Compliance Risk Score and Sanction Check & Risk Score.

tiers.name: Prime Plan
tiers.features: This is for prime contractors managing up to 5,000 suppliers. It includes all the features of the Supplier Plan plus the full DivedIn AI Package. The DivedIn AI package offers comprehensive tools for sanction screening, regulatory compliance risk assessment, and local content analysis (like the "Buy America" Act). The plan also includes ESG Metrics Solutions, which help with setting and tracking ESG goals and provide tools for supplier-based ESG scoring.

tiers.name: Corporate Plan
tiers.features: This is the enterprise-level plan for companies seeking full-scale supply chain risk assessment and resilience, for up to 25,000 suppliers. It includes everything from the Prime Plan, plus the full ESG & Sustainability Metrics Solutions. It also gives access to all available add-on functionalities and includes modules for Procurement & Sourcing and Resource Planning & Management.

tiers.name: Launch
tiers.features: This is a free plan designed for small non-profits, public schools, open-source groups, and social impact projects. Core Features: Includes operational and impact analytics, basic community and employee communication tools, and integrations with Zapier and Slack for data import/export. Support: Limited to self-serve tutorials and documentation.

tiers.name: Impact
tiers.features: Aimed at startups, B-corps, and mission-driven organizations with up to 300 employees. Includes all Launch plan features, plus: Carbon Accounting: Scope 1, 2, and 3 GHG and carbon accounting, including emissions targets, reduction, and forecasting. Data Collection: Custom forms and stakeholder surveys. Community & Stakeholder Tools: Features for managing community partnerships, supply chains, volunteering, fundraising, and donations. CRM: A community CRM with tracking for up to 500 contacts or employees.

tiers.name: Transform
tiers.features: This tier is for organizations with up to 3,000 employees that need integrated ESG and sustainability tools. Includes all Impact plan features, plus: ESG & Reporting: Materiality assessments and formal ESG reporting capabilities. Supply Chain: Environmental management features for the supply chain. Analytics: Premium analytics, measurement, and reporting. CRM & Communication: Unlimited community CRM contacts and advanced communication segmentation. Support & Access: Includes 24/7 premium support, a dedicated account manager, Single Sign-on (SSO), and approval workflows.

tiers.name: Enterprise ESG
tiers.features: For large, global organizations requiring comprehensive ESG management. Includes all Transform plan features, plus: Scalability: Supports unlimited chapters, brands, teams, or regions. Integrations: Full API access and the option for custom integrations. Services: Includes dedicated enterprise-level services.

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.features: This is for ESG and Sustainability Goals & KPI tracking and includes basic Carbon Footprint and Waste Calculators. It provides a launchpad for multiple users to log in and share information. Add-on option: Sustainability and ESG Consulting Packages starting at $10,000

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.features: This includes everything in the Basic Edition plus a complete Carbon Accounting solution for Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions data aggregation, calculation, and reporting according to the GHG protocol. Add-on option: Sustainability and ESG Consulting Packages starting at $10,000

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.features: This tier adds functionalities for suppliers and customers. It includes the Standard Edition features, as well as ESG Disclosures and ESG (Supplier) surveys. It also allows for the addition of custom apps.
